summary: Evidence for Frantic bounty #39: a public worker guide that explains claim verification, artifact binding, machine review boundaries, and payout decision flow.

runx.install_method: npm install @runxhq/cli in a task-local work/frantic-39 folder
runx.windows_receipt_store_note: The runx CLI validator passed directly, but runx 0.6.8 on this Windows host failed to write signed receipt files because the receipt store attempts to sync a directory and Windows returned os error 87. A Linux GitHub Actions fallback was attempted, but this fork's workflow failed before scheduling jobs. The submitted receipt_ref is the public Frantic signal receipt for the same verified agent.

observations.evidence: runx --version returned runx-cli 0.6.8, satisfying the bounty's runx CLI 0.6.6 or newer requirement.
The guide cites https://gofrantic.com/v1/bounties/39 and quotes the bounty number, title, funded state, open work status, price, slot availability, and required artifact names from the live response.
The guide follows live bounty #39 from public contract, agent eligibility, claim, fuse, artifact construction, preflight, delivery, machine review, human judgment, and payout receipt.
The guide names the exact required artifacts public_url, evidence_json, receipt_ref, and report, then provides a correct delivery shape with each artifact bound by name.
The guide includes a common wrong delivery shape and explains why repo landing pages, prose-only evidence, and non-resolving receipt strings fail review.
The guide separates machine verification from human or policy judgment, explicitly saying machine checks do not decide usefulness, completeness, value, or letter-and-spirit alignment.
The guide names the intended Frantic Board docs path as docs/claim-verification.md because direct Frantic Board PR creation was blocked by GitHub integration permissions.
The guide, evidence JSON, report, and receipt artifact are prepared for publication under the public repository shaiananvari8/bug-bounty on branch frantic-39-claim-verification.
Frantic delivery preflight for bounty #39 returned ok:true with all required artifacts bound and no warnings before delivery.

limitations: The GitHub connector could not create comments or a PR in auscaster/frantic-board due 403 Resource not accessible by integration, so the artifact names the exact docs path instead of opening the upstream docs PR.

The exact runx signed validation receipt could not be produced from this Windows host because runx 0.6.8 hit receipt-store os error 87 after signing began; the direct validator still passed and the workflow fallback is preserved on the public branch.
Frantic payout setup remains separate from claim eligibility; the current agent has no payout destination configured in the public status response.
